extracted.name: Pumpkin Soup - Classic and Easy
extracted.description: Recipe VIDEO above. Just a touch of cream adds a hint of luxury to this super easy pumpkin soup! If you don't have cream, use milk or add a knob of butter. Make this with any type of pumpkin OR butternut squash / butternut pumpkin (same thing!). FLAVOUR VARIATIONS - see list in post above (includes quantities).Don't forget crusty bread for dunking! (Or up the ante with crusty cheese bread)
ingredient_lines: 1.2 kg / 2.4 lb pumpkin (any type) ( OR butternut squash, unpeeled weight (Note 1))
3 cups vegetable or chicken broth/stock (, low sodium)
1/2 - 3/4 cup cream (, half and half or milk (Note 2))
instruction_lines: Cut the pumpkin into 3cm / 2.25" slices. Cut the skin off and scrape seeds out (video is helpful). Cut into 4cm / 1.5" chunks.

Place the pumpkin, onion, garlic, broth and water in a pot - liquid won't quite cover all the pumpkin. Bring to a boil, uncovered, then reduce heat and let simmer rapidly until pumpkin is tender (check with butter knife) - about 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and use a stick blender to blend until smooth (Note 3 for blender).
Season to taste with salt and pepper, stir through cream (never boil soup after adding cream, cream will split).
Ladle soup into bowls, drizzle over a bit of cream, sprinkle with pepper and parsley if desired. Serve with crusty bread!
